# cloudxino_container_host (Resource)

A Managed Container Service (MCS) host: a CC2 server of the team's own with Docker, Docker Compose, Traefik (automatic Let's Encrypt certificates) and Portainer, with a `docker-compose.yml` deployed to it. Billed per hour from the team's wallet (the server plus the management fee) until destroyed.

Creating one takes about 5 minutes; when `compose` is set it is deployed as soon as the host is ready. A change to `compose`, `env` or `domains` deploys again and waits for the deployment to finish. `compose`, `env` and `domains` are managed only when set: leave one out to manage it elsewhere (for example `cxctl containers deploy` from CI).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A managed container host that runs docker-compose.yml, with one secret and one HTTPS domain.
# Changing compose, env or domains deploys again; changing plan resizes the server in place.
resource "cloudxino_container_host" "apps" {
  name    = "apps"
  plan    = "s-2vcpu-4gb" # data.cloudxino_container_host_plans lists them
  compose = file("${path.module}/docker-compose.yml")

  env = {
    DATABASE_URL = var.database_url
  }

  domains = [
    { domain = "app.example.com", service = "web", port = 8080 },
  ]

  timeouts = {
    create = "45m"
  }
}

# Point the domain's A record at the host so Let's Encrypt can issue its certificate.
output "ip_address" {
  value = cloudxino_container_host.apps.ip_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1-63 letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit. Changing it replaces the host.
- `plan` (String) Plan slug, e.g. `s-2vcpu-4gb` (the `cloudxino_container_host_plans` data source lists them). Changing it resizes the server in place (about a minute of downtime); disks only grow, so a plan with a smaller disk is refused.

### Optional

- `compose` (String) The `docker-compose.yml` to deploy, e.g. `file("docker-compose.yml")`. Ports 80 and 443 belong to Traefik: publish services through `domains` instead. Left out = not managed by Terraform.
- `domains` (Attributes List) Domains served over HTTPS by Traefik, each routed to a compose service's port. Each domain's A record must point at `ip_address` for its certificate to be issued. Replaces all of the host's domains; `[]` removes them. Left out = not managed by Terraform. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `env` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variables for every service (also usable as `${NAME}` in the compose file). Replaces all of the host's variables; kept encrypted by the API, and in the Terraform state. Left out = not managed by Terraform.
- `project_id` (String) Left out = the team's default project. Changing it replaces the host (the API cannot move one).
- `region` (String) Region ID; left out = the default region. Changing it replaces the host.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The host's public IPv4 address: point your domains' A records here.
- `last_deployment` (Attributes) The newest deployment, whoever made it; null before the first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--last_deployment))
- `portainer_url` (String) Portainer's address. The first login is in the console (or `cxctl containers credentials`).
- `status` (String) `creating`, `installing`, `ready`, `failed`, `deleting` or `deleted`.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Required:

- `domain` (String) Full domain name in lowercase, e.g. `app.example.com`.
- `port` (Number) The port the service listens on inside its container.
- `service` (String) A service in the compose file.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--last_deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `last_deployment`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `number` (Number) 1, 2, ... per host.
- `status` (String) `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_container_host.apps <container_host_id>
```
